_note: Module-level set: the lowest module in a single file (a leaf, no child instances), and every tool and ours read ONLY that file. spimemio_xfer is defined in spimemio.v beside spimemio (which instantiates it); darkuart.v holds darkuart alone and includes ../rtl/config.vh. top_file names the file when it differs from the module. clock_reset lists the module's clock/reset ports for the minimal Yosys viz recipe. Ours is drawn by ours_modules.py into runs/x3_tool_compare/ours_modules/.
